preregistration.freeze_law: Thresholds are frozen in this spec. The gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame. Any threshold or geometry change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash; the receipt carries the hash of the spec actually applied.
preregistration.exception_law: A frame passes only via an exception declared in this spec. Every exception pass emits a machine receipt row carrying the frozen law citation and measured census evidence. Prose-only exceptions are refused.

floor_calibration_notes.clean_floors: FROZEN BY THE PREREG (section 5): body 300 (the X04 V1 census 385-418 px at this exact view), instrument 400 (the declared strip is 9537 px), tree 120, rock 25.
floor_calibration_notes.diag_floors: Authored BEFORE the sealed GREEN capture, disclosed (spec_version 3; v1/v2 were REFUSED evidence, never GREEN): on DIAGNOSTIC frames the frozen render order makes the L1 panel (x[12,300] y[40,190]) overlap the projected tree_far footprint (bbox x[58,124] y[78,205]) and COMPLETELY COVER the projected rock_far footprint (bbox x[145,190] y[157,187] - measured census: 743-769 palette px on every clean frame, 0 on every diagnostic frame of the v1/v2 evidence runs). The DIAG class therefore does NOT expect landmark_rock_far at all (v2's floor 0 still trips the template gate's co-location ratio on an empty footprint - the template's law, untouched); landmark_tree_far keeps a 60 px floor (partially covered), w10_diagnostic_marks 25 (the surviving contact pads + corner chip). The CLEAN-class floors are the prereg's own frozen numbers and are UNTOUCHED. The tick remains readable in the L2 declared layer.
floor_calibration_notes.clean_law: The X04-diagnostic and W10-diagnostic objects are declared so that any of their pixels on a CLEAN frame fail stage-1 accounting (UNDECLARED_MASK_ID): X05's clean law preserves X04 P7's substance.
